posts.name: bobbertoriley
posts.cooked:
Another feature request/issue with the new store.

Placed an order last week. When I check the status in the store, it's listed as "Delivered". Used USPS First Class shipping. However, I've not received the item. 

So, either there's a tracking number that should be exposed to the end user that I should be able to follow, or the store is presumptuous about the delivery status, and that's a bug. :) 

 

 

In addition, rather than relying on subscription notices from FedEx or any other service, it'd be really nice if the store provided a "Your item has shipped" email and, if a shipping number is available with the order, provide it with it. All things considered, this is a very basic feature in pretty much every Point of Sale workflow. I dunno why you guys don't have it, but you should.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
@bobbertoriley

Our previous web store did not have the ability to send out tracking info, since it could not be connected directly to shipping software. Our new web store has that ability, but it is very complicated to set up, and we are going to be working through all of the bugs first before we try to add new features. However, that is a long term goal!

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
Yes, for now.

Soon, all of the problems with contact@ should be resolved - we are hooking it into a customer service software solution to help manage tickets and requests, which should eliminate the dropped email problem we've had for quite a while.
